newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITSUI CON SUBMITS RESTRUCTURING PLAN-MITSUI TRUST.
newsitem.headline: MITSUI CON SUBMITS RESTRUCTURING PLAN-MITSUI TRUST.

text.p: Mitsui Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Wednesday that Mitsui Construction Co Ltd had submitted a restructuring plan and added that it was unlikely to reject it across-the board.
"Mitsui Construction submitted a new restructuring plan which included support from us," a Mitsui Trust spokesman said.
"We are considering whether we will accept it or not. We are unlikely to reject it across-the-board," he said without elaborating.
Mitsui Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd later said that it, Mitsui Trust and two other financial institutions belonging to the Mitsui group had decided to accept the restructuring plan.
